claim: A panning floor moves only while pan_always is set or the sector is busy; a belt that should stop and start is a pan_floor + drag sector without pan_always, toggled by its channel. Blood's belts are pan_floor, drag and a velocity: E3M5's at 48, angle 512.
evidence: E3M5 sector 44: pan_always 1, pan_floor 1, drag 1, pan_velocity 48, pan_angle 512; E6M3 and E4M9 the same at 10 and 20
use: Give a stoppable belt its lever on its own channel and leave pan_always off; a crusher over it can be wired so a press stopped shut is a belt stopped.

checked.how: Read NBlood/source/blood/src/sectorfx.cpp:265-300 (DoSectorPanning): :277 'if (pXSector->panAlways || pXSector->busy)'; busy is state<<16 once ON (triggers.cpp SetSectorState), scaled by busy while moving. actor.cpp:5411 and :5434 (actProcessSprites) drag only if panAlways || state || busy. Campaign scan: E3M5 s44 pan_always 1, pan_floor 1, drag 1, pan_velocity 48, pan_angle 512; E6M3 s150-151 velocity 10, E4M9 s79 ff. velocity 20; and switched belts without pan_always exist (E2M2 s34 rx 102, E2M7 s15-23 rx 147).
